7. Use standardized terminology and codes.

## 1. Start with the maintenance records

Before heading out to do a visual inspection, start with the maintenance records for the bridge. These records will give you valuable information on past defects and repairs, as well as any known structural issues. Inspecting the historical records will help you focus on areas that have been problematic in the past or are likely to develop problems based on past trends.
